quote_zh: 不同PH值下对析出的纯化环磺酮的氰化物杂质含量分析，处理方法：重排反应结束后，蒸馏脱溶后取产品5g溶解在20％含水乙醇中，升温至60℃，加入1g硅藻土保温一小时后热过滤，控温滴加10％稀盐酸调节PH分别为2、3、4、5，逐渐降温至15℃，过滤得纯化环磺酮。得以下数据： | 16 | 5 | 1238 | 82 | 88% |
arithmetic_check: No mass or mole pair is printed in this section, so there is no mass balance and no molecular weight to check; the only arithmetic on the page is the stated percentage reduction against its own two ppm figures. Printed for batch 16 at PH 5: original cyanide impurity content 1238 ppm, content after crystallisation 82 ppm, stated reduction 88%. Computed from the printed pair: (1238 - 82) / 1238 = 93.38% reduction, equivalently 6.62% of the original content remaining. The printed and computed reductions DISAGREE, so it does not close, and mass_balance_implausible is raised for it with a note that the flag is being used for a percentage rather than a mass because arithmetic_inconsistent is not in the closed enum. Nothing printed was changed. All four rows of this table were checked and all four fail the same way. Separately: the 5 g charge cannot be checked against the precursor's output because Synthesis Scheme::Step 2 states no product mass, so scale_discontinuity was not raised and that is a check that could not run, not a pass. Note also that the four batches together draw 20 g from a crude batch whose size the document never states.
